attempts.text:
Only Uttargaya shelter is an evacuation point; Kakani temple is not designated, so nobody can be dropped there.

**Road status**
- **Usable:** Trishuli–Bidur (7 min), Uttargaya–Bidur (17), Syaphru–Trishuli (8), Galchhi–Syaphru (20), Uttargaya–Kakani (48), Syaphru–Bidur (11)
- **Closed:** Galchhi–Trishuli (bridge gone), Uttargaya–Gajuri (flooded), Uttargaya–Syaphru (collapsed)

**Who is waiting**
- Kakani temple: 3 elderly, 4 adults
- Bidur temple: 3 adults
- Syaphru farm: 3 elderly
- Trishuli village: 3 injured

**Plan**
- **Car1** makes one round trip to Kakani (96 min). It brings back the 3 elderly and 1 adult, which avoids 170 in penalties. A second trip would also cost 96 min but would only avoid 60 in penalties for the last 3 adults. So those 3 adults are deferred.
- **Car2** makes two loops through Bidur.
  - Loop 1 picks up the 3 injured at Trishuli and 1 adult at Bidur (48 min).
  - Loop 2 picks up the 3 elderly at Syaphru and 1 adult at Bidur (56 min).
  - The last Bidur adult is deferred, since an extra trip (34 min) would cost more than the deferral (20).

<plan>
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter kakani-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 kakani-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
defer kakani-temple adult 3
drive car2 uttargaya-shelter bidur-temple
drive car2 bidur-temple trishuli-village
load car2 injured 3
drive car2 trishuli-village bidur-temple
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 bidur-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car2 injured 3
unload car2 adult 1
drive car2 uttargaya-shelter bidur-temple
drive car2 bidur-temple syaphru-farm
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 syaphru-farm bidur-temple
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 bidur-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car2 elderly 3
unload car2 adult 1
defer bidur-temple adult 1
</plan>

**Total cost**
- Driving: 96 + 48 + 56 = 200
- Penalties: 4 adults × 20 = 80
- Total: 280

COST: 280
